notes: CS3-era binary FLA (OLE2 compound) — the XFL scanner cannot read it; census below was recovered from the file's own strings in-memory, byte-exact, without modifying the file.

Recovered named sets: eye shapes ANGRY_EYES / CRYING_EYES / CUTE_EYES / CLOSED_EYES (incl. angry-hold and desperate variants), CLOSED_EYES_FOR_EATING_HEAD, BIG_CHEEK_HEAD and BIG_CHEEK_HEAD_02 with mouth-open / mouth-closed shapes, EAR_01, CLEAN_EYES_LINES.

The file carries the puppet block's own annotation text: 'Eyes shapes for standard head', 'Mouth shapes for head with a big cheek', 'Mouth shapes for lipsynch', '(for eating head shapes)' — the same notes ship inside the Hector CS3 puppet.

media.note: Model-sheet render staged in render_model_sheets.sh; the sandbox write guard currently refuses rendered-binary writes (EPERM/0 bytes). Census and catalog are unaffected.
